title: 30-case dataset + scorers + prompt experiments
acceptance_criterion: Every promoted case is traceable and held-out data has not influenced tuning
stdout:
Phase 3 shipped. 30 cases across 6 families, frozen 18/6/6 dev/val/held-out split; the held-out
set is content-hashed into HELD_OUT_SHA256.txt and is not read by any tuning path. Node and task
scorers with 16 unit tests. 3-prompt comparison ran live (18 runs) under one matched budget;
v1_baseline + v2_structured advance to the topology comparison, v3_minimal is the published
unsuccessful change.

Measured: all three prompt versions score 0/6 task_success. Per EVIDENCE_CARD this is the
conservative substring-match scorer (semantically-correct answers scored false), documented as a
limitation rather than a regression.
evidence: fixtures/cases/: dev=18, val=6, held_out=6 (= 30) case files; fixtures/cases/HELD_OUT_SHA256.txt = d3bef8c3...d8d0a5
experiments/prompts-v1/{report.md,outcomes.jsonl} — 18 live runs (6 val cases x 3 prompt versions) on MiniMax-M3
report.md: v1_baseline / v2_structured selected; v3_minimal published as the unsuccessful change (no system prompt)

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is reconstructed from the shipped artifacts under apps/agentops-workbench/ plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. exit_code / acceptance_met are judgements against the shipped tree, not a recorded process exit.
